task_name: Client contracts — types and API surface

strengths: TrackerProject, TrackerPhase, TrackerStatusCategory, and enriched TrackerItem/TrackerVocabulary types align with server payloads — raw foreign keys only, no embedded names, progress, rollup, or overdue fields

All project, phase, reorder, and extended updateTrackerItem API methods follow the existing request<T> pattern and match shipped server routes (including flat /tracker/phases/:id for phase PATCH/DELETE)
18 client tracker API tests pass; commit 5aaad1c uses feat(tracker): message and touches only the three scoped files

issues.description: TrackerItem new fields use optional nullable (projectId?: number | null) rather than required nullable as the plan specified; callers may omit keys that the server always serializes
updateTrackerPhase patch type supports startDate/endDate but the test only asserts name/version forwarding; date body serialization is untested
TrackerVocabulary.category is optional (category?:) rather than required nullable; acceptable for priority/label vocab but looser than the four-value union spec wording for statuses
